Coram : ARIJIT PASAYAT*, P.P. NAOLEKAR
Criminal trial-Pending for six years-Trial Court closing evidence and acquitting accused in view of decision in Raj Deo Sharma v. State of Bihar, [1998) 7 SCC 507-High Court upholding same-On appeal, Held: Decision in Constitution Bench in A.R. AntulaY.'s case [1992) 1 SCC 225 continues to hold Raj Deo Sharma (1) and Raj Deo Sharma (Il) cannot be sustained as they were rendered by bench of two or three Judges and run counter to the view expressed in A. R. Antulay's case. A B c Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973-Section 309-Trial pending for D long period-Trial Court directed to take up
